Kerala ADGP cleared of corruption allegations over Punyam Poonkavanam project

The Kerala government has given a clean chit to ADGP P Vijayan in connection with the Punyam Poonkavanam project. The government rejected Ajith Kumar's finding, which alleged corruption in the project. The project will continue as planned. The opposition had accused the government of favoring certain contractors. The police claimed that no irregularities were found during their investigation.
